translation:
The ten untreatable conditions (十不治證):
When a fall or blow injures the lung, even if one does not die immediately, it is hard to pass fourteen days; when the left flank is wounded through to the inside; when the intestines are injured and severed; when the lower abdomen is injured within; when the signs and symptoms are numerous and varied; when the testicles are wounded and broken; when an old person's left thigh is crushed; when the blood has all come out; when the shoulder, within the ear and behind, is wounded through to the inside; when the pulse is not firm and heavy.
For all of the above, one need not use medicine.
